column1: # Brighter-pixel census across faint overlay texts. Written and committed BEFORE any item was measured (2026-10-14).
# Windows are master pixels, inclusive. Chosen from gridded views only; no census statistic was computed when choosing them.
# METHOD (one method, every item; implemented in overlay_census.py)
#   fill    = mode of L over the window. Eligible only if the mode covers >= 50% of the window; otherwise SKIPPED, reported.
#   clipped = fill >= 250: a neighbour cannot exceed the fill by much, so the item cannot show the signature -> EXCLUDED, reported.
#   mask    = window pixels with L <= fill - 4 (the dark marks). Empty mask -> NO DARK MARKS, reported.
#   nbrs    = pixels within 2 px of the mask (8-connected dilation x2), not in the mask, inside the window.
#   result  = count and max of nbrs with L >= fill + 1, out of len(nbrs). Also reported: depth = fill - min(L in mask), and
#             FAR = window pixels with L >= fill + 1 farther than 2 px from any mask pixel.
#   shows   = count > 0 and FAR == 0.  count > 0 with FAR > 0 -> INDETERMINATE (the fill itself exceeds the mode).
#   Decision set = roles overlay-s9 and overlay-numeral. Write "the tablet marks share the rendering signature of the faint
#   overlay texts" only if the subject shows it, EVERY decision-set item is eligible and shows it, and NO eligible control shows
#   it. A skipped, excluded or indeterminate decision-set item counts as not shown. Anything else is reported as mixed.
#   Items with role additional are measured and reported but are outside the rule (faint text that the s9 census does not list,
#   or s9 elements judged by eye to be drawn rather than overlaid).
#   No reading of what any item says.
